title: Orion S.A. Declares Interim Quarterly Dividend
summary: HOUSTON, September 17, 2026--Orion S.A. (NYSE: OEC), a global specialty chemicals company, today announced that its Board of Directors has declared an interim dividend to be paid in the first quarter of 2027 of $0.0207 per common share of the company, which is equivalent to the aggregate amount of approximately $1.2 million based on the number of common shares currently outstanding.
